  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel - Channel Partnerships & Alliances to join our US Legal Team. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. In the Commercial Counsel - Partnerships role specifically, you will work on partnership arrangements including ISV integrations, SI alliances, reseller channels, and strategic referral networks. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end legal strategy and execution for ElevenLabs’ partnership ecosystem, including ISV and platform integration agreements, systems integrator and consulting partnerships, channel partner programs, reseller and distribution arrangements, marketplace agreements, embedded and OEM-style arrangements, and strategic alliance structures.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, with a primary focus on Partnerships deals and enterprise customer contracts

  • Serve as the primary legal partner to ElevenLabs’ Partnerships team, providing strategic counsel that balances risk management with speed-to-market and aggressive growth objectives.

  • Design, maintain, and continuously improve scalable partnership templates, playbooks, approval workflows, and contracting infrastructure that enable the business to evaluate and execute deals efficiently.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth and innovation.

  • Contribute to scaling the Legal Team’s commercial function, fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

  • Build scalable legal infrastructure for global partner motions, including reseller frameworks, marketplace terms, partner program agreements, approval workflows, and operational playbooks.

Who you are

  • Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions.

  • Experience supporting complex partner business models including reseller, referral, MSP, OEM, embedded, white-label, and marketplace structures.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues.

  • Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success.

  • Experience negotiating with major systems integrators and consultancies (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, Big 4) and leading ISVs and cloud platforms.

  • Hunger to be exceptional at your job.

What you bring

  • J.D. and active membership in at least one U.S. State Bar (NY preferred).

  • 7+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience (in-house experience in technology or SaaS strongly preferred).

  • Proven track record drafting and negotiating complex technology and partnership agreements—ISV, SI, reseller, channel, marketplace, OEM/embedded, and strategic alliance arrangements.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise software licensing, SaaS, data protection, and intellectual property.

  • Experience designing and launching channel partner, reseller, or marketplace programs from the ground up.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth.   • E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption.

  • Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting.

  • Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area.

  • Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

  • Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

  • 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution.

  • Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

  • Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

About the role

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in Australia, at ElevenLabs you will play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives.

We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology.

In this role you will:

  • Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market.

  • Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers

  • Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion.

  • Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends.

  • Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop.

  • Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results.

 

Requirements

  • 2-3 years outbound B2B sales experience with a track record of securing new business meetings.

  • Demonstrated ability to build Opportunity sized lead lists in new markets and categories

  • Experience with full suite of prospecting tools

  • Demonstrated ability to build, scale process

  • Demonstrated ability to nurture a team

  • Curiosity - asking insightful questions and developing solutions from a foundation of knowledge and insight.

  • Self-motivated, thriving as part of a team while possessing the ability to stay driven and proactive independently.

  • Effective time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage a high volume of leads.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a brand new Adoption Strategist role sitting at the intersection of adoption, enablement, scaled programs, and product expertise so we expect the scope to evolve and want someone excited to build as it does. You'll design and run the programs - onboarding tracks, lifecycle campaigns, workshops, adoption playbooks - that drive corporate and mid-market customers to activate their core use case and expand into new ones. Everything you build has to scale across a high-volume book, not be custom to one account. You'll need deep product fluency - enough to be the most credible voice in the room on how to use the product well - without ever owning an account or its technical implementation directly. This is a builder role for someone extremely analytical, comfortable running live enablement at scale, and already advanced with AI tools to automate the systems behind it.

Since this is a new role, we expect the scope to evolve over time - being adaptable and excited to build is a core part of being successful here. Focus areas include, but aren't limited to:

  • Drive strong adoption by building and delivering scalable enablement and activation programs that educate customers on best practices, and get them to time-to-value quickly on their core use case

  • Develop deep product expertise across the entire ElevenLabs platform, with a focus on ElevenAgents and ElevenCreative - you're a product expert on our existing product and you're constantly the first to learn new products coming to market

  • Proactively audit customer agents prompts, configurations, and feature setup to identify gaps, and share recommendations as a value-add service that drives deeper adoption

  • Track and drive key leading and lagging adoption metrics, partnering with Revenue Operations to iterate on our reporting capabilities, and use those trends to develop data-driven adoption strategies and playbooks across the customer base in region

  • Partner with Account Management and CX to deliver targeted adoption and enablement campaigns, including regional live workshops and webinars, based on opportunities or new product releases

  • Engage with external implementation partner and internal teams to help unify adoption strategy across the customer journey (e.g., Solutions Engineering, GTM, Customer Experience, Product Marketing and Engineering)

  • Partner with leadership on high-impact initiatives that support the local GTM team and global results

Requirements

  • 6+ years in adoption, customer/partner enablement, digital CS programs, enterprise growth or similar role- at an AI-native or highly technical company with a large, low-touch book

  • Experience with voice AI, TTS, conversational AI, or developer-facing products

  • A track record of building adoption focused programs from the ground up: onboarding tracks, scaled adoption playbooks, self-serve content, and more

  • You think in systems but are creative: you're always asking "how do we scale or automate this," and building automations and workflows with AI tools is ingrained in how you work

  • Extremely analytical: you identify trends easily and use them to close gaps, surface opportunities or standardize best practices. You also identify data points that aren't yet tracked but would uncover new insights and change strategy

  • Comfortable driving cross-functional outcomes without direct authority, working effectively with Account Management, FDE, RevOps, and GTM to move adoption forward

  • Experience managing a high-volume book of business at scale, mid-market or commercial segment

  • Language Requirements - Must be fluent in Spanish/Portuguese and English

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Growth Roles - Regional Adoption Lead

  • Other teams: Account Management, Digital CX or Deployment Strategist

Location

This role can be based in Argentina or Brazil


We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

As the Account Management Lead you'll lead a team of experienced account managers across the UK&I region. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value to customers and the business.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing AM team, owning team and regional NRR performance, customer retention, and expansion goals.

  • Act as a player-coach: directly manage priority accounts, join key customer conversations, and model best-in-class success practices.

  • Lead by example in complex post-sales and renewal cycles, unblocking issues, driving adoption, and identifying expansion opportunities.

  • Set strategic direction for the team, aligning customer success initiatives with company goals and market trends.

  • Monitor and optimize delivery quality across all accounts, ensuring consistency, excellence, and predictability in customer outcomes, implementing scalable processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and operational efficiency.

  • Design and implement repeatable playbooks for renewals, upsells, and adoption; automate workflows and tools to scale team impact.

  • Own the ongoing development and optimization of best practices for Commercial and Scale playbooks, ensuring consistent execution, measurable impact, and continuous refinement as the business evolves.

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across priority accounts, serving as a strategic advisor and customer advocate in internal and external forums.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, operations, and revenue strategies.

  • Partner with Europe GTM & cross functional leadership to align organizational objectives, drive cross-functional initiatives, and ensure cohesive execution across customer success, sales, and operations teams.

Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in Account Management or post-sales roles within SaaS, ideally some of this within UK&I accounts.

• Demonstrated technical acumen with the ability to upskill and enable the team — fostering confidence in navigating product capabilities, integrations, and data insights to strengthen customer outcomes.

• 5+ years of direct people leadership experience — managing AMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for developing people and building a high-performance, feedback-driven culture grounded in accountability, learning, and customer impact.

• Strong player-coach mindset: comfortable managing key accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.

• Demonstrated success in exceeding renewal, expansion, and NRR goals through effective customer engagement and strategic account management.

• Expertise in CS methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling, executive alignment).

• Strong analytical and operational skills: adept at using data to identify performance trends, optimise workflows, and forecast outcomes.

• Strong builder mindset - you thrive in building from scratch, redefining processes and playbooks, and operating with an AI-first mindset

• Bonus: Hands-on with tools (Salesforce, Gong, Sigma, Pylon) and capable of improving data quality, visibility, and usage insights across the team.

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere within UK&I. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Dublin.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

We are seeking a seasoned Growth Marketer to lead our expansion into the Nordics Region. We need a builder who is comfortable with the "zero-to-one" phase of regional growth.

You will be the local "Source of Truth" for marketing, acting as a creative, an analyst, and an operator all at once. You should be someone who enjoys the complexity of multi-lingual markets and has the drive to implement projects from start to finish while owning the outcome entirely.

Your Responsibilities

  • Regional Growth Engine: Make sure Nordics B2B grows through aggressive lead generation and brand awareness.

  • Outbound Strategy: Build and execute complex, multi-language outbound sequences that cut through the noise.

  • Local Events: End-to-end ownership of local industry events, user conferences, and webinars in the region.

  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate with performance marketing on ABM initiatives and localized retargeting.

  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor campaign performance, produce executive-level reporting, and recommend data-driven optimizations.

  • Localization & Messaging: Adapt ElevenLabs’ global voice to resonate deeply with the Nordics business cultures.

Requirements

  • One of the 4 Nordic languages is a must

  • Fluent English speaker.

  • Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

  • Entrepreneurial Background: You have a strong drive and a history of high engagement, ideally in an entrepreneurial endeavor or a similar high-stakes environment.

  • Thrives in Chaos: You are energized by a dynamic, ever-changing environment and can manage multiple workstreams without losing focus.

  • The "Jack of All Trades": Broad knowledge in growth marketing, ranging from numbers analysis and performance knowledge to campaign planning and event organizing.

  • DRI Mentality: Ability to act as the local Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for all marketing operations.

Bonus Experience

  • Proficiency in cold email, SEO, or affiliate management.

  • Product marketing sense and design skills.

  • Deep understanding of the Northern European tech ecosystem and buying-cycle shifts.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture & growth paths.

  • Annual discretionary L&D stipend & social travel stipend.

  • Annual company offsite.

  • Monthly co-working stipend.

#LI-Remote

About the role

Brazil and LATAM are among our fastest-growing markets globally, and we’re looking for a highly motivated Events Marketer to lead planning and execution of impactful events across Brazil and the broader LATAM region, as part of our Brazil- and LATAM-focused GTM motion. Your work will deepen ElevenLabs’ presence, drive brand awareness, and generate high-quality pipeline in partnership with our Brazil GM and regional GTM teams.

You’ll own the full lifecycle of in-person owned events, third-party tech conferences, executive dinners, workshops, webinars, sponsorships, and strategic partnerships. You’ll adapt and localize successful global playbooks while identifying new, high-impact opportunities unique to the Brazilian and wider LATAM markets.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and execute event plans aligned with business objectives across São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and key markets in Brazil and LATAM

  • Organise third-party conferences, owned branded events, and strategic dinners with key customers and prospects across Brazil and LATAM

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and GTM teams for seamless execution

  • Create compelling event messaging that resonates with Brazilian and LATAM business audiences

  • Manage event budgets and timelines end to end

  • Analyze event performance and provide recommendations for future improvements

  • Build and maintain relationships with sponsors, partners, and vendors across Brazil and LATAM

What you bring:

  • 5+ years events experience, with at least three in tech event marketing

  • Native Portuguese speaker, English fluency required (Spanish a plus)

  • Deep knowledge of the Brazilian and LATAM tech ecosystems and key industry events, including events in São Paulo and beyond

  • Experience working with Brazilian and LATAM event agencies and production partners

Location

This role is remote within Brazil. Preferred to be based in São Paulo.

We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across the Nordic's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Financial Services. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major financial institutions in the Nordics — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across the Nordics, with a primary focus on Financial Services & Insurance, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for financial services institutions.

  3. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  4. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to regulated financial services organizations in the Nordics.

  5. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  6. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the financial services sector in the Nordics, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

  7. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  8. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  • Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  • Well-connected in the Nordics financial services landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  • Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in the Nordics, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  • Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  • A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

  • Native or full professional proficiency in Swedish or Danish; strong English for internal collaboration.

Location

This is an in-country role with a preference for a candidate based in Stockholm or Copenhagen You can work remotely or from our office in Stockholm.

We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across the Nordic's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Financial Services. In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

 1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across the Nordics, with a primary focus on Financial Services & Insurance, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

About the role
We're looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Strategic Account Executive who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don't just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with our strategic enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will:

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts in the UAE to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  • Identify and develop high-value business opportunities that align with ElevenLabs' product offering and roadmap.

  • Generate leads, negotiate complex contracts and close sales in collaboration with the Growth team.

  • Be responsible for KPI and sales performance tracking, providing weekly updates to the wider ElevenLabs team.

Who you are
We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You'll strive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

  • Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

  • Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

  • Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment, selling into large and strategic enterprises in the UAE

  • +10 years of previous experience in sales in a SaaS organisation, with experience managing strategic, complex, deal cycles.

  • Extensive experience working in the UAE

  • Expertise or willingness to learn everything about Voice AI industry and how ElevenLabs' solution can help.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

  • A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritises client impact, satisfaction & scale.

  • The role is based in the UAE

  • Plus: Proficiency in Arabic.

About the Role

We’re launching dedicated Digital Natives coverage in North America, a new team built to serve companies whose products and business models are built around technology. These are cloud-first, developer-led organizations that build fast, scale fast, and evaluate vendors the way engineers do.

This is a named account role with a focused portfolio of the most strategic digital native companies in the region. You will be full-cycle - driving new business, as well as expansion inside organizations where the buyer is often a CTO, VP of Engineering, or Head of Product, and where adoption frequently starts with a developer and an API key before it becomes an enterprise relationship. Your job is to find that momentum, multi-thread across technical and business stakeholders, and turn it into durable, multi-product partnerships.

These aren’t transactional engagements. You’ll architect solutions that span across our ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative, and ElevenAPI platforms that require cross-functional collaboration to deliver measurable outcomes, and bring field intelligence directly into our product roadmap. You’re not just executing a playbook, you’re writing it.

In This Role You Will

  • Own and grow a focused portfolio of named digital-native accounts in North America, driving both net-new business and expansion

  • Identify where our technology is already being used or evaluated inside an account and convert developer-led adoption into company-wide commitments

  • Develop and execute multi-year account strategies across product lines, teams, and use cases

  • Scope and close large ($xM+), complex deals, including multi-product, usage-based, and custom commercial structures

  • Build deep, multi-threaded relationships across engineering, product, platform, and executive stakeholders

  • Act as a strategic advisor on how AI voice and multi-modal agents fit into customers’ product roadmaps and architecture

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships to deliver and expand value

  • Translate patterns from this segment into repeatable frameworks, offerings, and product insights that inform how we expand Digital Natives coverage to other regions and verticals

  • Feed learnings from the field into the product roadmap and the broader strategic sales playbook

  • Drive creative outbound and high-touch engagement strategies (onsites, technical deep dives, exec briefings, developer and founder events)

Requirements

  • 6-10+ years of quota-carrying experience with a focus on strategic or enterprise accounts

  • Experience selling to technology companies, high-growth startups, or developer-led organizations, ideally API, infrastructure, or platform products

  • Proven track record of closing and expanding seven-figure+ deals within named accounts

  • Experience leading complex, multi-threaded sales cycles where engineering and product leaders are the primary decision-makers

  • Strong ability to drive land-and-expand motions, including converting self-serve or usage-based adoption into enterprise agreements

  • Experience scoping consultative, custom deals that go beyond standard SKUs

  • Deep technical fluency, able to engage CTOs and engineering leaders credibly on APIs, integrations, latency, and architecture

  • Executive presence with the ability to influence founders and C-suite stakeholders on long-term AI strategy

  • Track record of translating customer needs into product feedback and roadmap influence

  • Creative, self-driven approach to outbound and pipeline generation

  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, ambiguous environment, building a new coverage model from scratch

  • Willingness to travel for customer engagements (onsites, QBRs, executive meetings)

  • Strong bias toward action, ownership, and leveraging AI in day-to-day workflows

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role
You’ll build the tools that make Studio a video editor people want to live in. These include transitions, color grading and elements libraries all built on top of our in-house engine. You’ll also build presets, so a user can get the effect they want without tweaking 20 individual controls.
The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment.
You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required.


Requirements

  • Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs.

  • Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, but deep backend expertise isn’t needed.

  • Evidence of product responsibility: side projects, open source, or product-facing work.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, startup-style environment, and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding.

About the role:

We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Poland's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Financial Services. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Polish financial institutions — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Poland, with a primary focus on Financial Services & Insurance, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for financial services institutions.

  3. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  4. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to regulated Polish financial services organizations.

  5. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  6. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Polish financial services sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

  7. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  8. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements

  1. 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  2. Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  3. Well-connected in the Polish financial services landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  4. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  5. Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Poland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  6. Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  7. Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  8. A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

  9. Native or full professional proficiency in Polish; strong English for internal collaboration.

Location:

This is an in-country role with a preference for a candidate based in Warsaw.


#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in LATAM Southern Cone. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

As our first marketing hire in LATAM Southern Cone, your work will shape how Southern Cone businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 

What you'll do

  • Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Southern Cone priority industries — from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

  • Own field marketing for the region: plan and run self-hosted events (dinners, roundtables, workshops), represent ElevenLabs at third-party conferences and sponsorships, and bring in creative, high-touch formats (experiential activations, executive dinners, partner co-hosted sessions) that build pipeline and brand with technical buyers.

  • Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound — choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

  • Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Southern Cone market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

  • Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

  • Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

 

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

  • Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

  • Deep knowledge of the Southern Cone market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

  • Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

  • Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

  • Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out.

It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done.

You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. The AE continues to own the account and the relationship. Your job is to make sure we win the deal and that it's structured to set us and the customer up for long-term success.

The work doesn't stop at one deal. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered.

This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function.

In this role you will

  • Lead strategic deals. Own the pursuit strategy for our largest and most complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with account teams from qualification through close. Help decide which pursuits warrant this level of investment and where your time goes.

  • Build executive engagement. Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Bring together Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and executive sponsors to accelerate deal progression and remove blockers. Run the pursuit like a program, with a clear plan, owners, and a cadence, without becoming the bottleneck.

  • Structure and win complex transactions. Drive competitive strategy, solution design, commercial models, negotiations, and creative deal structures (multi-year commitments, partnerships, co-development, platform and marketplace models, and others we haven't invented yet) to secure transformational agreements that are good for the customer and for ElevenLabs.

  • Work across senior stakeholders on both sides. Navigate complex buying committees, procurement, legal, and in some cases boards and investors, and keep the deal moving when it gets stuck at the top.

  • Partner on global and strategic accounts. Work closely with regional leaders and account teams on our most important global accounts, bringing a consistent strategy across regions and product lines.

  • Build repeatable winning motions. Turn strategic deals into scalable playbooks, improve pricing and packaging, influence product priorities with evidence from the largest deals in the market, and ensure successful handoffs into deployment.

  • Raise the bar on deal craft across the org. Coach AEs and regional leaders on executive selling, business case development, and deal structuring so the whole Revenue organization gets better at winning big.

  • Be the CRO's partner on big bets. Bring a clear point of view on which deals to pursue, how to structure them, and when to walk away, and represent that view in leadership and executive forums.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, strategic deals, or business development at technology companies, with a track record of leading and closing very large, complex, multi-year transactions.

  • Deep deal structuring experience. You have personally designed and negotiated creative commercial structures and know how to make the economics work for both sides while protecting the business.

  • Executive presence. You are credible with C-suite executives at the largest enterprises in the world and can hold the room alongside our CRO and CEO.

  • Comfort outside the playbook. You thrive in deals that don't follow a standard process, and you know when to break the playbook and when to rely on it.

  • Cross-functional orchestration. You can rally Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and executives around a deal when none of them report to you, and you do it by being prepared, decisive, and easy to work with.

  • Business case and value fluency. You can build a credible, quantified business case tied to customer outcomes and defend it to a CFO.

  • Strong commercial judgment. You understand pricing, margin, and long-term account economics, and you know the difference between a big deal and a good deal.

  • Technical fluency. You understand AI and platform products well enough to shape solution design and hold your own with a customer's CTO.

  • Operator mentality. You care about what happens after signature, and you make sure what we sold gets deployed successfully.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable leading pursuits with teams and customers across AMER, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and India.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 40% of the time, often with customers' and ElevenLabs' executives.

Bonus points

  • Experience building or leading a strategic pursuits, strategic deals, or global accounts function at a high-growth AI, cloud, or enterprise software company.

  • Experience selling AI, voice, conversational AI, or platform/API products to large enterprises.

  • Experience structuring partnerships, marketplace, or co-sell agreements alongside direct deals.

  • Experience in a company where the product and the market move weekly and deals have to keep up.

Location

This is a remote global role within the Revenue organization. You will travel up to 50% for

customer and executive meetings and for working sessions with regional sales leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our Legal Team in India. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions across India and where necessary, the broader APAC region, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, with a primary focus on GTM/Sales transactions in India, including enterprise customer contracts.

  • Partner with sales, business development, and operations teams to design and implement strategies that support high-growth go-to-market initiatives.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving region specific legal and regulatory developments, including data protection, technology, and AI-related frameworks, and apply this knowledge to contract drafting and risk assessment.

  • Develop, maintain, and localize contract templates, playbooks, and policies to reflect regional requirements and industry best practices.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth and innovation.

  • Contribute to scaling the Legal Team’s commercial function, fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

Who you are

  • Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • Have worked for a US Based or Global multinational out of India but have direct experience working with customers both in and outside the region.

  • Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues.

  • Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success.

  • Hunger to be exceptional at your job.

What you bring

  • Law degree and qualification to practice law in India

  • 7+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience (in-house experience in technology or SaaS strongly preferred).

  • Proven track record drafting and negotiating complex commercial and technology agreements.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise software licensing, SaaS, data protection, and intellectual property.

  • Experience advising on privacy, cybersecurity, and cross-border data transfer issues.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines

Location

This role is remote, so it can be executed from anywhere in India. We’re particularly looking for candidates based in Bengalaru, Delhi, Chennai, Mumbai, Hyderabad.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions.

We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure.

Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents.

The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked.

What you will do

  • Identify and build opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue

  • Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration

  • Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems

  • Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance

  • Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems

Requirements

  • Strong experience building production web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies

  • Experience independently taking projects from an initial idea through launch and measurable impact

  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify friction, form hypotheses, and prioritize opportunities

  • Experience working with analytics, funnels, experimentation, SQL, and product or business metrics

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy, shipping quickly, and collaborating across engineering, design, product, data, and marketing

Bonus

  • Experience working as a Growth Engineer, Product Engineer, startup founder, or early-stage engineer

  • Experience building programmatic SEO systems or scaling large numbers of landing pages

  • Experience with technical SEO, experimentation platforms, feature flags, or A/B testing

  • Experience improving onboarding, activation, monetization, referral, or sharing flows

  • A portfolio of side projects, products, automations, or experiments you have launched

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own a major acquisition, activation, or monetization area across ElevenLabs

  • Lead the strategy and technical direction for organic growth, conversion, or experimentation

  • Build and lead a larger Growth Engineering function

  • Expand into broader product engineering or growth leadership

  • Take ownership of company-level growth metrics and cross-functional growth initiatives

Location

This role is remote and can be executed from the US East Coast or Europe, with sufficient working-hour overlap with the broader team.

You may also work from one of our offices, including London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw, and other ElevenLabs locations.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions.

We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure.

Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents.

The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked.



What you will do

 - Identify and build opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue

 - Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration

 - Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems

 - Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance

 - Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems



Requirements

 - Strong experience building production web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies

 - Experience independently taking projects from an initial idea through launch and measurable impact

 - Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify friction, form hypotheses, and prioritize opportunities

 - Experience working with analytics, funnels, experimentation, SQL, and product or business metrics

 - Comfortable operating with high autonomy, shipping quickly, and collaborating across engineering, design, product, data, and marketing



Bonus

 - Experience working as a Growth Engineer, Product Engineer, startup founder, or early-stage engineer

 - Experience building programmatic SEO systems or scaling large numbers of landing pages

 - Experience with technical SEO, experimentation platforms, feature flags, or A/B testing

 - Experience improving onboarding, activation, monetization, referral, or sharing flows

 - A portfolio of side projects, products, automations, or experiments you have launched



Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

 - Own a major acquisition, activation, or monetization area across ElevenLabs

 - Lead the strategy and technical direction for organic growth, conversion, or experimentation

 - Build and lead a larger Growth Engineering function

 - Expand into broader product engineering or growth leadership

 - Take ownership of company-level growth metrics and cross-functional growth initiatives



Location

This role is remote and can be executed from the US East Coast or Europe, with sufficient working-hour overlap with the broader team.

You may also work from one of our offices, including London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw, and other ElevenLabs locations.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer - Sweden
jobs.descriptionHtml:

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta.   • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll work as part of a driven team to unlock the full potential of our voice AI platform for a growing customer base. Your mission is to efficiently scale our technical solutions to many enterprise customers, both directly and by improving our internal processes and supporting our sales teams.

As a Solutions Engineer, you can expect to:

  • Collaborate strategically with Account Executives to enhance the technical aspects of the sales process.

  • Work directly with technical contacts from our customers and prospective customers to provide bespoke support and architect solutions.

  • Craft compelling technical demonstrations that clearly communicate our product's value proposition.

  • Create technical enablement resources that amplify our sales team's effectiveness and technical fluency.

  • Build self-service tools and documentation that empower customers to implement solutions independently.

  • Identify opportunities to productize common integration patterns or features, and work with our product teams to make these real!

Requirements

We're looking for exceptional individuals who excel at working with customers on technical problems and excited to work with us to scale this efficiently. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

  • Enjoy working directly with customers, iterating on solutions and providing tailored support

  • Have a talent for identifying patterns that can be standardized and scaled.

  • Have strong empathy for customers, sales and product teams.

  • Have a strong technical background in order to help customers architect integration between our solutions and their existing solutions

  • Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

  • Proficiency in Python, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and common integration patterns.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences.

    Location

    This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Sweden, with a preference of Stockholm. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Swedish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We're looking for an experienced, driven Senior Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Poland's largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Government & Utilities. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Polish institutions — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Poland, with a primary focus on Government & Utilities, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  • Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency across Government & Utility institutions.

  • Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends.

  • Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  • Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Polish Government sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  • Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  • Well-connected in the Polish Government and Utilities landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  • Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Poland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  • Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  • A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes customer satisfaction and scale.

  • Native or full professional proficiency in Polish; strong English for internal collaboration.

Location:

This is an in-country role with a preference for a candidate based in Warsaw.

#LI-remote

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

  • Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

  • Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

  • Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

  • Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

  • Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

  • Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

  • Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

  • Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

  • You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

  • You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

  • You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

  • You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:

Primary requirements

  • 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

  • A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.

  • Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

  • Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

Also required

  • Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

  • Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

  • Public policy experience across France.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Location

This role is located in France.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

 - Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

 - Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

 - Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

 - Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

 - Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

 - Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

 - Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

 - Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

 - Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

 - You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

 - You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

 - You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

 - You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

 - You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

Primary requirements

 - 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

 - Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

 - Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

 - Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

 - Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

 - Public policy experience across France.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

 - Fluency in English and French.

This role is located in France.
