  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate.

You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them.

 

No two days are the same, but you should expect to:

  • Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points.

  • Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region.

  • Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions.

  • Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations.

  • Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness.

  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

  • Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models.

  • Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers.

  • Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies.

 

Requirements

  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations.

  • People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.

  • Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

  • Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications.

  • Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact.

  • Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Saudi Arabia or UAE. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Arabic and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Act as the liaison between the deployment team and other parts of the organisation to ensure coordinated alignment.

  • Are an excellent communicator able to triage technical issues.

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our team in Revenue Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member serves as a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function, whether that's SDRs, AEs, Partnerships, or Account Management.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness.

  • Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting.

  • Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area.

  • Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across their associated functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement.

  • Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

  • Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

  • Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

  • 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution.

  • Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps

  • Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

  • Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

What we offer

  • High-velocity innovation: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • A truly global team: Collaboration with teammates across 30+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)

  • Remote first: We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.

  • Continuous growth: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Growth PM to own data and growth experimentation across the full funnel, from landing page through to in-app and pricing. ElevenLabs drives significant paid and organic traffic across self-serve, developer, and enterprise funnels; your job is to turn more of it into subscriptions, pipeline, and revenue.

You'll own the experimentation engine end to end: uncovering opportunities through funnel and product data, building and prioritizing the testing backlog, designing and evaluating experiments, and owning the tracking and reporting that turns results into decisions. Your scope runs deeper than conversion optimization: you'll drive experiments across onboarding, activation, and pricing, and align paid media, design, engineering, and product teams around one optimization roadmap.

The ideal candidate is equal parts analyst, strategist, and operator: someone who finds revenue hiding in funnel and product data, ships a high-velocity testing program, and communicates results in terms of subscriptions and pipeline, not just conversion rates.

Requirements

  • A track record of running high-velocity experimentation programs end to end - hypothesis, prioritization, test design, and analysis - with measurable revenue impact

  • Experience running experiments beyond the marketing site: in-product (onboarding, activation) and pricing or monetization

  • Deep analytics fluency: comfortable living in product analytics tools (e.g., PostHog, Amplitude, GA4) to diagnose funnel drop-off, segment traffic, and attribute outcomes across multi-domain journeys

  • Strong statistical literacy: you know how to size tests, avoid false winners, and choose the right success metric (revenue and subscriptions over clicks)

  • A cross-functional operator who can align paid media, design, engineering, and product teams around a shared optimization roadmap

Bonus

  • Working front-end web development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React) to build test variants without waiting on engineering

  • Experience optimizing PLG/self-serve funnels alongside sales-assisted (demo/contact-sales) funnels

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#Li-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

ElevenLabs is building the creative suite for the AI generation. It's time to turn that signal into a real program.

We are looking for an Influencer Marketer to build our influencer program from zero to one. You will own the entire channel: strategy, creator sourcing and vetting, deal negotiation, briefs and creative direction, campaign execution around product launches, and measurement. This is not a coordination role — you will be the owner and operator of a channel we believe can become one of our biggest growth levers.

We are looking for the top 1% of people in this industry. The right person has already taken an influencer program from nothing to something — with real numbers to prove it — and wants to do it again with more budget, a better product, and a faster team.   • Design and build the ElevenLabs influencer program from the ground up: strategy, creator tiers, budget allocation, and operating playbook

  • Source, vet, and sign creators across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X whose audiences match our creator, marketer, and developer segments

  • Negotiate and structure deals — flat-fee integrations, performance hybrids, long-term ambassadorships — and manage creator contracts with Legal

  • Write briefs that protect brand quality while giving creators room to be authentic, and give fast, decisive feedback on draft content

  • Plan and execute creator campaigns around product launches, feature releases, and cultural moments across ElevenLabs and ElevenCreative

  • Own measurement: work with our data team on attribution and incrementality (we already run a halo attribution model), and make continue/pause/scale calls on every creator and agency based on true ROI

  • Partner with paid marketing on whitelisting and amplifying top creator content, and with social to extend campaign reach

  • Build repeatable systems — sourcing pipelines, rate benchmarks, brief templates, reporting — so the program scales beyond you

Requirements

  • A proven track record of building an influencer program from zero to a meaningful, measurable channel — you can walk us through the before and after with real numbers

  • Experience negotiating and closing creator deals across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and/or X, including non-standard structures (performance hybrids, ambassadorships, usage rights)

  • Fluency in measurement beyond last-click: promo codes, UTMs, lift studies, incrementality, and the judgment to make budget calls when attribution is imperfect

  • Sharp creator taste — you can tell which creators will move the needle for a product like ours and which will just burn budget

  • Excellent brief-writing and creative feedback skills; you raise content quality without killing authenticity

  • Experience managing meaningful budgets and working cross-functionally with paid, social, product marketing, data, and legal

  • A genuine understanding of the AI and creative tools landscape — you follow the space, use the tools, and have informed opinions about where things are headed

Bonus

  • Built or scaled an influencer program at a creative tools, AI, or developer-facing company (e.g., Canva, Adobe, Figma, Notion, Runway, or similar)

  • Managed 7-figure annual creator/sponsorship budgets

  • Experience on the agency or creator side of the table — you know how the other side negotiates

  • Built adjacent programs: ambassador, affiliate, or B2B thought-leader partnerships

  • Multilingual capabilities

  • Lead the influencer and creator partnerships function as the program scales, building a team around you

  • Expand into broader creator/community growth ownership across ElevenLabs brands

  • Move into growth or brand marketing leadership as the Growth org evolves

Location

This role is remote-first and can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and Europe, with the ability to collaborate across EST–CET timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

We’re looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Account Executive in Spanish Latam who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with organizations to help them generate new experiences and monetization opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will:

  1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals

  2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency

  3. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends

  4. Demonstrate expertise—or a strong willingness to learn—about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and more

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of sales experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API platforms

  • Experience selling technical solutions to product, engineering, or innovation teams is a strong plus

  • Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment

  • Expertise or willingness to learn everything about voice and audio AI and how our solutions can help prospects

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale

  • Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in Chile, with preference for Santiago or Lima.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Sales Execution & NA Enablement Lead to raise how our enterprise sellers plan, pursue, and win complex, technical deals. This is not a traditional training role. You’ll set the standard for what great enterprise selling looks like, turn it into artifacts and operating rhythms, and make sure sellers and managers actually use it.

The role has two mandates: own key global sales execution programs, and act as the primary Enablement partner to North America sales leadership. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of Enablement, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product & Technical Enablement, and FDE.

What you’ll do

  • Own enterprise sales execution: Build and operationalize the critical artifacts that drive excellent sales execution.

  • Enable sellers to win technical enterprise deals: Coach reps to build business cases with champions, read 10-Ks, and connect ElevenLabs capabilities to measurable outcomes for technical and economic buyers.

  • Partner with NA leadership on enablement: Diagnose field gaps and adapt global programs to NA needs, including competitive positioning, developer-led motions, and vertical playbooks.

  • Facilitate globally: Lead highly engaging, practical sales execution sessions, not just build the programs behind them.

  • Manage the coaching and operating rhythm: Embed selling standards and artifacts into how managers inspect deals and coach sellers.

  • Build the foundation for a vertical selling motion: Lay the groundwork for vertical selling, which is becoming a global priority, not just an NA need.

  • Execute in an AI-native way: Use AI to scale coaching, practice, and reinforcement, going beyond general AI fluency.

Requirements

  • 10+ years experience in enterprise sales leadership and enablement experience, ideally in an AI-native or developer-focused company

  • Excellence building and operationalizing value-selling artifacts across sales org with measurable results

  • Experience with MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar methodologies, and the judgment to adapt them

  • Experience enabling frontline sales managers and building strong coaching methodologies

  • AI fluency, and comfort building in a fast-growing environment where the operating model is still taking shape

  • Enough technical depth to credibly support sellers selling to developers and technical buyers

  • Proven cross-functional influence across Sales, RevOps, PMM, Product, and FDE teams

  • Bonus: Experience working in voice AI

Location

This is a remote-first role. Candidates must be based in North America.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.

Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers)

  • Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.

  • Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

  • Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.

  • Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.

  • Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

  • Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.

  • Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.

  • Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.

  • Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.

  • Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

  • Strong test design and security fundamentals.

  • Care and attention to detail when changing live, business-critical systems, and the ability to learn a large existing codebase quickly.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: working out what should be built, and prioritising among competing signals.

Bonus:

  • Experience with authentication, authorization or permissioning (OAuth, SSO/SCIM, RBAC or similar).

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience building internal platforms or services used by other engineering teams.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative.

You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day.

What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it.

This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with:

  • Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships)

  • GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure)

You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed.

What you’ll do

  • Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of

  • Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value

  • Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence

  • Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires

  • Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content current as products ship

  • Craft realistic practice environments: demo certifications, role-play scenarios, and customer simulations with scored feedback, built on our own agent technology

  • Operate AI-natively: use ElevenLabs’ own voice and agent technology to build training and practice environments; default to AI tools to build faster, and teach others to do the same

  • Measure what matters: define and track the percent of sellers certified within 2 weeks of GA, demo and pitch quality scores, and win rate and stage progression against named competitors, and use the data to improve each launch

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who knows our products well and can teach sellers to demo and sell them. You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Have 4-7+ years as an enterprise seller or solutions engineer, or as a seller who moved into product marketing or enablement, at a SaaS, platform, or API-first company

  • Are hands-on with agents, APIs, or creative tools, and understand at a conceptual level how they work

  • Have demoed and pitched technical products to customers, and can explain the value, not only the features

  • Have a track record of teaching, mentoring, or building training, in addition to your customer-facing work

  • Are comfortable building a program from scratch, with no playbook to inherit

  • Have credibility with sellers, built from time in the seat or supporting sellers directly, and work well with product marketing, research, and engineering teams

  • Communicate clearly and can adapt product material for different audiences without diluting it

Bonus

  • Experience at a high-growth AI/ML, developer tools, or API-first company

  • Background in voice AI, conversational AI, or contact center technology

  • Vertical depth in financial services, healthcare, telecom or CCaaS, or at other AI companies

  • Hands-on experience with competing voice and agent platforms

  • Experience running workshops or labs for sellers or customers

  • Experience building role-play, simulation, or demo practice environments

Location

Remote-first, globally distributed role. Expect occasional travel to team hubs and onboarding sessions. Candidates should be able to work effectively across US and European time zones.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:

  • Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.

  • Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events.

  • Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers.

  • Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements.

  • Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.

  • Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause.

  • Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company.

Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

  • Expertise in Python.

  • A strong background in backend development.

  • Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

  • Strong test design and security fundamentals.

  • Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

  • The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.

Bonus:

  • Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

  • Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

  • Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.

You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

  • Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

  • Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

  • Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

Who you are

  • Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

  • Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

  • Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

  • Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

  • Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

We are looking for freelance Audiobook Specialists to join our fast-growing Productions team. Productions is a new marketplace that brings together our AI audio tools and a network of human experts to unlock high-quality, human-edited transcripts, subtitles, dubs, audiobooks and more at scale for our users and customers. While Productions is just getting started, we already manage content workflows for some of the world’s top YouTube channels, book publishers, and media & entertainment businesses.

Here’s what you can expect on our team:

  • Editing and polishing AI-generated audiobook narrations for natural flow and consistency

  • Ensuring character voices, tone, and pacing align with the author’s intent

  • Voice casting and direction to match the style of the book

  • Collaborating with our audio engineering and mixing teams on mastering and post-production

  • Competitive task-based compensation

  • Flexible workload and scheduling

Requirements:

  • Native or near-native fluency in English (and/or other supported languages)

  • Prior experience in audiobook narration, production, or editing

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to audio and linguistic accuracy

  • Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work on time

Bonus:

  • Previous work with publishers, audiobook production companies, or audio post-production teams

  • Experience using the ElevenLabs platform and/or other AI-assisted narration tools

  • Proficiency in audiobook post-processing and editing (meeting industry specs, mastering, and using a DAW such as Pro Tools, Audition, or Reaper)

This role is remote and can be executed globally.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Finance Data Scientist to join our central Data team as the first dedicated analytics partner to Finance. You'll turn billing, revenue and forecasting data into audit-ready numbers, and the analysis that shapes pricing and planning decisions as we scale towards IPO.

  • Own finance-facing analysis: revenue and ARR reconciliation, cohort and retention economics, pricing and packaging experiments.

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified finance KPI layer (ARR, billing, revenue), and be the first to catch when a number is quietly wrong.

  • Build forecasting and scenario models that FP&A uses directly in planning and board reporting.

  • Translate ambiguous finance questions from FP&A, RevOps and leadership into clear, reusable analysis.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist or analyst embedded with a Finance / FP&A function, ideally at a growth-stage or pre-IPO company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with comfort reconciling data across Stripe, Salesforce and a dbt-modelled warehouse.

  • Finance fluency: ARR, billing, revenue recognition, cohort economics — you can speak FP&A's language.

  • Rigour around data quality: you reconcile by default and can explain a variance, not just report it.

  • Strong stakeholder management with Finance leadership, and the ability to push back on ambiguous asks.

Bonus

  • Experience preparing finance data for audit, SOX or IPO readiness.

  • Experience with pricing / packaging experimentation or revenue forecasting at a subscription or usage-based business.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse (BigQuery), partnering directly with analytics engineers.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Lead Finance Data Scientist role as the central Data team scales.

  • Expand scope into broader strategic finance or RevOps analytics.

  • Path into a Head of FP&A Analytics or data leadership track.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab, and working to restore the voices of one million people living with permanent voice loss through our 1 Million Voices initiative (learn more at elevenlabs.io/impact). We're looking for a Producer to own the external storytelling and event presence for Impact, a role that coordinates PR, agency management, social launches, documentary-style case studies, and event production. This is a hands-on, in-house role: you're the person who makes sure every launch, film, and activation meets (or, ideally raises) the bar of the rest of the company's output, working closely with our internal Design, Comms, and Events teams, and, when applicable, with the external agencies and production teams supporting PR, film, and creative execution. Much of Impact’s work is made with people who live with a disability, or are members of vulnerable communities. You will ensure their views carry equal weight and their input helps shape every project, from first conversation to final cut. As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast; this quarter alone includes more than five events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight.

What you'll do

  • Coordinate production of Impact's documentary case studies: travel and work onsite for filming when needed, work closely with external production and direction teams, bringing opinions on story and craft, and partner with our Design team to make sure every film meets ElevenLabs' bar and brand guidelines.

  • Work alongside subjects of our case studies, many of whom live with a disability, as equals and ensure that the production team does the same. You will build in consent, access needs, and editorial input at every stage to ensure alignment in how the story is told, cut, and shared.

  • Plan and execute Impact's conferences and activations alongside the Events team, turning each one into an in-person moment that drives real ROI and leaves a lasting impression, with Impact's own storytelling angle built in.

  • Support Comms in telling Impact's story through PR, coordinating with Comms and, when applicable, a PR agency to keep press windows and partner announcements on track, and helping make sure Impact's international stories get told well as the program expands globally.

  • Partner with Design to keep all video and static collateral on-brand, advocating for a high creative standard and Impact’s lens.

  • Carry a consistent visual and narrative thread across launches, blog content, and ElevenLabs Summit presentations.

  • Draft copy for social and blog content, collaborating with Comms to land a final draft, and with Design on all launch-related visual assets.

  • Manage multiple concurrent launches, shoots, and events at once.

Requirements

  • A great project manager with a sharp creative eye, someone who runs cross-functional logistics flawlessly, has real taste, and will push the team to hit it.

  • Proven practical experience working with vulnerable communities, especially people living with a disability, and ensuring they are provided the time, space and accommodation to be equal partners in high-pressure productions, on tight timelines, and in public.

  • Organized and detail-oriented, with a track record of juggling several production timelines at once.

  • Creative or production background (agency, marketing, in-house brand/content team, documentary or branded content) comfortable being on set and in the room with Design, not just commissioning the work.

  • Strong writing and visual taste; can tell when something is on-brand and polish-worthy.

  • 2-5 years of experience in production, events, or brand marketing.

  • Comfortable traveling for shoots and events.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

 

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

  • Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

  • Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.

  • Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

  • Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life.

  • Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact.

  • Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

  • Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap.

  • Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers.

  • Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes.

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. Direct enterprise customer experience is preferred.

  • Experience in product development, delivery, and change management

  • Commercial instinct: comfort engaging in deal conversations, structuring value propositions, and navigating enterprise sales cycles alongside GTM partners.

  • Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with API integration, sufficient to prototype, demo, and communicate credibly with engineering teams.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions.

  • A proven track record of taking ownership of complex, ambiguous projects and delivering results.

  • Adaptability to work across different customer environments, industries, and technical use cases.

  • Technical aptitude and familiarity with common LLM, tooling and AI agent frameworks.

  • Ability to creatively map enterprise use cases and workflows to AI systems

     

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Colombia, with a preference of Bogota. Expect regular travel for customer onsite. Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

 - Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

 - Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.

 - Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions.

 - A proven track record of taking ownership of complex, ambiguous projects and delivering results.

 - Adaptability to work across different customer environments, industries, and technical use cases.

 - Technical aptitude and familiarity with common LLM, tooling and AI agent frameworks.

 - Ability to creatively map enterprise use cases and workflows to AI systems

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Colombia, with a preference of Bogota. Expect regular travel for customer onsite. Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences.

  • The candidate should preferably be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

About the role

We are looking for freelance Translators and Linguists to join our fast-growing Productions team.

Productions is a new marketplace that brings together our AI audio tools and a network of human experts to unlock high-quality, human-edited transcripts, subtitles, dubs, audiobooks, and more at scale for our users and customers. While Productions is just getting started, we already manage content workflows for some of the world’s top YouTube channels, book publishers, and media & entertainment businesses.

As a Translator / Linguist, you will play a critical role in ensuring that content translated with the support of AI meets the highest standards of linguistic accuracy, cultural nuance, and natural flow.

Here’s what you can expect on our team:

  • Editing and refining AI-assisted translations for fluency, tone, and cultural appropriateness

  • Localizing scripts for dubbing, voiceover, and multimedia content

  • Ensuring terminology consistency across projects and maintaining glossaries where needed

  • Collaborating with dubbing and audio teams to ensure translations perform well in spoken form

  • Competitive task-based compensation

  • Flexible workload and scheduling - claim and complete jobs directly on our platform

Requirements

  • Native or near-native fluency in one or more supported languages

  • Proven experience in professional translation and/or localization

  • Strong understanding of cultural nuance and audience adaptation

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to linguistic accuracy

  • Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work on time

Bonus

  • Experience translating audiovisual content (film, YouTube, e-learning, podcasts, audiobooks)

  • Experience working with language service providers, localization teams, or media companies

  • Familiarity with subtitle editors, CAT tools, or AI-assisted translation workflows

  • Experience using the ElevenLabs platform and/or other AI-powered localization tools

  • Background in linguistics, translation studies, or language technology

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We're looking for a RevOps Systems Architect to help build a modern, AI-powered revenue operations stack. This isn't a traditional Salesforce admin role. We're building a GTM tech stack where AI is a first-class citizen, automations are genuinely intelligent, and our CRM is a living system that reflects how our business actually works.

You'll function as a Salesforce admin and backend developer in one. You'll own platform administration, build complex automations via Flows and Apex, and develop and maintain custom services and integrations, including Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that connect our CRM to the broader systems our team runs on. For larger engineering efforts, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our engineering team, scoping and shipping together.

In this role, you will:

  • Administer our Salesforce org: object model, data architecture, user configuration, and platform health.

  • Build and maintain automations via Salesforce Flows, Apex, and custom services that power our GTM processes end to end.

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that extend CRM functionality into AI-powered workflows.

  • Design and maintain SQL-based data pipelines that feed dashboards and revenue reporting across the org.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Expertise or willingness to learn everything about Voice AI industry and how ElevenLabs' solution can help.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

  • Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

  • Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

  • Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

  • Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

  • Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

  • Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

 - Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

 - Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

 - Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.




REQUIREMENTS

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

 - Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

 - Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

 - Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

 - Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

  • You measure whether what you built worked

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the financial services industry.

  • Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, digital), and to risk and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, model risk, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology and eager to act as a strategic partner, helping Fortune 500 and large-scale consumer companies reimagine how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers.

  • Identify opportunities where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in both customer facing and internal agentic workflows, such as customer care, qualification and bookings, helpdesk, learning and development, brand voice across marketing and localization and many more.

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends like agentic commerce

  • Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about how ElevenLabs' voice technology unlocks value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and creative content

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Operations, Digital and Product, Marketing and Brand, Technology), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across business units, brands, and markets

  • Serve as a trusted advisor, educating clients on generative AI and voice, and help shape the Consumer Brands playbook: ICP, messaging, and references

  • Experience selling to consumer-facing enterprises (QSR, grocery/retail, CPG, travel/hospitality/airlines) is a strong plus

  • Proven success closing seven-figure deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, marketing and brand), and translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and unique requirements for success, and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, with the ability to work autonomously and effectively as a cross functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level, and willingness to travel frequently and proactively for onsite client visits and conferences

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

About the role

We're hiring a Head of Financial Services to own ElevenLabs' US business across banking and insurance. Financial institutions want agents that talk to customers, policyholders, and advisors and that are safe, compliant, and compatible with the systems they already run. You'll own the financial services business from strategy and pipeline through to the team that delivers the revenue.

We don't use traditional job titles at ElevenLabs. This role is equivalent in scope and seniority to a Vice President of Financial Services, with ownership of the vertical, authority to hire and lead the sales team, and the chance to work closely with ElevenLabs leaders across the company.

Financial services buyers hold vendors to a high bar on risk, compliance, and reliability, and we're looking for a leader who has met that bar before. You'll build the financial services business end to end, including the strategy, team, pipeline, and playbook. You'll stay close to the most strategic deals while hiring and developing the leaders who will run segments as the business grows.

In this role you will

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy across banking and insurance.

  • Own the financial services revenue number, forecast accuracy, pipeline quality, and sales process, working with Revenue Operations on clean data and clear insight.

  • Recruit and lead the sales team, starting with Account Executives and adding segment leaders as the business grows. Coach reps on deal strategy and execution, and develop future leaders.

  • Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for banking and for insurance, which differ in buyers, regulators, and priorities.

  • Lead the largest strategic pursuits with your team, and own the executive relationships at our most important banks and insurers.

  • Build the customer reference base that establishes ElevenLabs as a trusted partner across banking and insurance.

  • Build our approach to model-risk, architecture, and vendor security review, and develop the executive relationships with Risk, Compliance, and InfoSec leaders that large institutions require.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success leaders to shape what we build, deploy, and bring to market for financial institutions.

  • Establish how we land and expand with each institution, from first deployment through enterprise-wide adoption.

  • Define our position against build-vs-buy decisions and platform bundlers.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at industry events and in high-stakes negotiations.

What we're looking for

  • 10-15+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 5 years leading sales teams.

  • A track record selling into banks and/or insurers, with experience working through Risk, Compliance, and InfoSec reviews.

  • A record of earning the trust of senior banking and insurance leaders, and of bringing new technology into their organizations.

  • Working fluency in banking and insurance regulation, including model risk, third-party risk, data protection, and consumer protection.

  • A history of closing at least seven-figure enterprise deals in complex, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Comfort moving between a C-suite briefing and the details of a prospecting list or Proof of Value.

Preferred

  • Experience building a sales motion or playbook from the ground up, whether as a founding leader or inside a larger company.

  • Fluency with AI products and workflows.

  • Interest in voice and conversational AI.

Why this role

The opportunity is to define the strategy, hire the team, and shape what we build for financial services, with support from leadership and a company growing as fast as ElevenLabs.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
