  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.

You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax.

Requirements

  • Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure

  • Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates)

  • Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision

  • Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors

  • Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation

  • CPA

Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house

  • Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring.

  • Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

Equity is a big part of how we reward the people building ElevenLabs, and the programme is growing fast across many countries. You'll own the day-to-day running of it: keeping our cap table accurate and audit-ready, and making sure every grant, exercise and leaver is handled correctly and on time.

You'll work with Finance, Legal and People to turn board-approved decisions into clean records and clear communication. That includes issuing grants, supporting 409A and local valuations, and answering employee questions about their equity.

We're looking for someone who is meticulous about the numbers and who treats employees as customers. You'll find ways to automate the repetitive work, using AI wherever it makes things faster and more reliable.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience administering equity in a cap table or stock plan platform such as Carta, including grants, vesting, exercises, terminations, settlements and reconciliations.

  • Experience administering equity across multiple jurisdictions, including tracking globally mobile participants and coordinating with Tax and Payroll.

  • Strong understanding of stock options, RSUs, vesting schedules and employee lifecycle changes, with working knowledge of relevant tax-advantaged schemes such as US ISOs and UK EMI or CSOP plans.

  • Experience reconciling equity data with People, Talent, Payroll and Accounting records.

  • Understanding of stock-based compensation accounting sufficient to provide reliable data and support Finance with US GAAP and local reporting requirements.

  • Experience building and documenting equity processes and controls, managing deadlines independently and resolving discrepancies.

  • Clear communication skills, sound judgement when handling confidential information and a strong focus on employee support.

Bonus:

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, familiarity with 409A processes, or a record of automating equity workflows.

  • Certification (e.g. CEP or similar)

  • Experience with IPO process or having supported transition from private to public

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Central Europe or Eastern US. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York and Warsaw.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role

ElevenLabs runs a deliberately lean finance team across 10+ legal entities and 40+ countries. The stack is built around NetSuite, Stripe, Ramp, Deel, HiBob and Pigment, with a BigQuery/dbt warehouse underneath. We want a close where people review exceptions and agents handle the rest. You'll own that stack, from architecture and integrations to controls and vendors. This is a builder role, not a ticket queue.

  • Run NetSuite end to end. That covers multi-subsidiary setup, chart of accounts and segments, scripting and workflows, release management, and roles and segregation of duties as we build toward public-company controls.

  • Own the integration layer: Stripe, Ramp, Deel and HiBob into NetSuite, and NetSuite into the warehouse. Month-end should reconcile by design instead of by hand.

  • Lead selection and rollout of new systems, including usage-based billing and equity administration. You'll also handle the finance setup of every new entity.

  • Build with AI, alongside our Automations and Data teams. Examples include agents and automations for invoice coding, people-cost reconciliations and accounting requests.

  • Be the systems voice in finance decisions on new pricing models, new geographies and audit readiness.

Requirements

  • You've administered a multi-entity NetSuite OneWorld instance yourself, including SuiteScript/SuiteQL, saved searches, roles and releases.

  • You've owned an ERP or billing implementation or migration end to end, and you know how Stripe data flows into the ERP and into revenue recognition.

  • You build integrations, through iPaaS or code, that reconcile and alert when something breaks, and you're comfortable in SQL.

  • You understand R2R, P2P and O2C and the controls behind them, and you can work with accountants, engineers and auditors in the same week.

  • You work AI-first: tools like Claude Code or Cursor are part of your day, and you automate a workflow before you staff it.

  • Bonus: experience with Ramp, Pigment, Metronome or another usage-billing platform, Deel/HiBob, or n8n, or dbt/BigQuery; SOX or ITGC work at a pre-IPO or public company.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead a Finance Systems & Automation team as the company scales.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in CET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Warsaw and London.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Head of Healthcare to own ElevenLabs' US healthcare business across providers, payers, and life sciences. Health organizations want agents that talk to patients, members, and clinicians and that are safe, fast, and compatible with the systems they already run. You'll own the healthcare business from strategy and pipeline through to the team that delivers the revenue.

We don't use traditional job titles at ElevenLabs. This role is equivalent in scope and seniority to a Vice President of Healthcare, with ownership of the vertical, authority to hire and lead the sales team, and the chance to work closely with ElevenLabs leaders across the company.

Healthcare buyers hold vendors to a high bar on safety, compliance, and reliability, and we're looking for a leader who has met that bar before. You'll build the healthcare business end to end, including the strategy, team, pipeline, and playbook. You'll stay close to the most strategic deals while hiring and developing the leaders who will run segments as the business grows.

In this role you will

  • Define and execute the healthcare go-to-market strategy across health systems, payers, and life sciences (pharma and medtech).

  • Own the healthcare revenue number, forecast accuracy, pipeline quality, and sales process, working with Revenue Operations on clean data and clear insight.

  • Recruit and lead the sales team, starting with Account Executives and adding segment leaders as the business grows. Coach reps on deal strategy and execution, and develop future leaders.

  • Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment.

  • Lead the largest strategic pursuits with your team, and own the executive relationships at our most important health systems, payers, and life sciences companies.

  • Build the customer reference base that establishes ElevenLabs as a trusted partner across healthcare.

  • Build our approach to BAA, security, and AI governance review (including MLR for pharma), and develop the executive relationships with Compliance, Privacy, and IT security leaders that health organizations require.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Customer Success leaders to shape what we build, integrate, and bring to market for health organizations.

  • Establish how we land and expand with each health organization, from first deployment through enterprise-wide adoption.

  • Define our position against build-vs-buy decisions, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at industry events and in high-stakes negotiations.

What we're looking for

  • 10-15+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 5 years leading sales teams.

  • A track record selling into health systems, payers, or life sciences, with deep fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, AI governance, and long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • A record of earning the trust of senior health system, payer, or life sciences leaders, and of bringing new technology into their organizations.

  • A history of closing at least seven-figure enterprise deals.

  • Comfort moving between a C-suite briefing and the details of a prospecting list or Proof of Value.

Preferred

  • Experience building a sales motion or playbook from the ground up, whether as a founding leader or inside a larger company.

  • Fluency with AI products and workflows.

  • Interest in voice and conversational AI.

Why this role

The opportunity is to define the strategy, hire the team, and shape what we build for healthcare, with support from leadership and a company growing as fast as ElevenLabs.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale ElevenLabs' Public Sector Partner Programme in North America — bringing together resellers, VARs, and systems integrators who help deploy our technology across federal agencies, state and local governments, and education institutions.

You'll own the public sector partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs and VARs with established public sector practices, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products into government and education accounts.

This is a 0→1 build: you'll design partner incentive and enablement models tailored to the procurement and compliance realities of the public sector, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against North America growth targets — while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.

 

What success looks like (first 6–9 months)

  • Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through VARs, SIs, and channel partners reaching at least 20% of North America public sector revenue

  • Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise and agency-level opportunities in federal, SLED, and education

  • Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter

  • Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal

  • Strategic Account Penetration: new agency and institution relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly

Requirements

  • 10+ years building and scaling SaaS or Cloud solutions into public sector markets, with a deep network across federal, SLED, and education that you can leverage from day one

  • 4+ years owning VAR and SI partnerships in the public sector, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell motions, and revenue — not just relationship management

  • Deep familiarity with government procurement cycles, contract vehicles (e.g. GSA schedules, BPAs), and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, StateRAMP)

  • A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

  • Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and agency stakeholders

Bonus: Mix of 3–4 years in direct public sector sales + 3–4 years in partnerships or channel; prior experience at a company scaling into gov-tech from a commercial base

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We build an ads engine that learns as it goes: brand book, taste, and what actually performs in every market. It plans, generates, localizes, launches and learns from ads across the major ad platforms, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack.
You’ll be a founding engineer for a product area of your own. There’s no PM and no handed-down spec. You’ll talk to users, decide what to build, and ship it across the stack, from data pipelines and agent tools to the UI. Early work could include feeding competitive intelligence into the engine’s weekly briefs or launching a new ad format.
We’re looking for founders and founding engineers. You’d rather ship a rough v0 on Friday than a perfect design doc. Strong engineering is the minimum. What sets people apart is product judgment and ownership.

Requirements

  • Has built and shipped a product end-to-end without anyone handing them a spec, ideally as a founder or one of the first engineers.

  • Strong full-stack product engineer (frontend- or backend-leaning is fine) who can build a pipeline, an agent tool and the UI

  • Builds with LLMs and agents pragmatically: tools, retrieval and evals, not model research.

  • Talks to users without being asked, and can say what they’d build first and why.

Bonus: experience with ad platforms, adtech or marketing tools; analytics and attribution; web builders and CMSs; taste in creative.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and India, with the ability to operate in European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

About the role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration.

Developer Growth owns the surfaces developers and their agents use: our SDKs, API, documentation and ElevenAPI dashboard. This role focuses on the dashboard and product flows, helping self-serve and enterprise developers get started, understand their usage and get more value from ElevenLabs.

You will join a small, remote team and own features across frontend and backend. You will use direct user feedback and experiments to decide what to build, combining strong engineering with a careful eye for developer experience.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving the ElevenAPI dashboard so developers can manage integrations and understand how their applications and agents use ElevenLabs.

  • Streamlining onboarding, helping developers create API keys, get started with agents and reach their first successful integration.

  • Designing and shipping experiments to improve activation, API key creation and self-serve subscriptions, then using the results to guide further changes.

  • Owning features from discovery and design through frontend, backend, deployment and iteration, working closely with the team and learning from users.

There is scope to grow into technical and team leadership over time, depending on your experience and impact.

Requirements

  • Strong full-stack engineering skills, with particular strength in frontend development and confidence building backend services and APIs.

  • Strong product judgement and attention to UX, with evidence of making complex workflows intuitive for developers.

  • Experience using user feedback, product data and experimentation to prioritise work and improve measurable outcomes.

  • Independent, end-to-end ownership, clear communication and genuine enthusiasm for developer tools and developer experience.

  • Experience managing or mentoring a small team of software engineers

Prior generative audio experience is not required. Experience building developer-facing products, API dashboards or onboarding flows is particularly valuable. Previous technical or team leadership experience is a plus.

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs operates a complex and fast-evolving revenue model – enterprise contracts, self-serve API subscriptions, usage-based billing, and expanding international markets. As a Revenue Accountant, you will play a key role in ElevenLabs’ revenue accounting function.

You will own significant portions of the monthly revenue close, support the application of ASC 606 to customer arrangements, and help build scalable processes and controls as ElevenLabs grows toward IPO readiness.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Billing Operations, Engineering, and FP&A to support contract review, usage and billing completeness, new product launches, and accurate and timely revenue recognition. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a lean Finance team – the right person will independently run recurring workstreams, identify issues early, and help scale the revenue accounting operating model as the business grows.

What you’ll do

  • Execute significant portions of the monthly revenue close, including journal entries, deferred and unbilled revenue schedules, reconciliations, and flux analysis

  • Perform recurring usage / consumption completeness and billing-to-GL reconciliations; investigate exceptions and drive resolution with cross-functional partners

  • Review customer contracts and apply established ASC 606 guidance to standard arrangements; escalate novel, high-judgment, or precedent-setting matters

  • Support accounting for credits, refunds, contract modifications, cutoff, and variable consideration, with clear and audit-ready documentation

  • Prepare revenue workpapers, audit support, and control evidence; support external audit, walkthroughs, and SOX readiness activities

  • Support accounting readiness and UAT for new products, pricing structures, billing models, and partner / channel launches

  • Improve and automate recurring revenue processes, reconciliations, documentation, and exception reporting as the business scales

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in ASC 606, including multi-element arrangements, SSP evaluation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and principal vs. agent analysis

  • Experience leading the revenue close: deferred revenue management, unbilled receivables, journal entry review, and month-end flux analysis

  • Track record of partnering with Sales and Legal on contract review and revenue impact assessments

  • Experience operating in a pre-IPO or public company environment, with direct exposure to external audit, controls build-out, and revenue accounting documentation

  • CPA, ACA, or ACCA qualification (active); Big 4 or public accounting background a strong plus

  • Strong systems proficiency; Stripe, Metronome, HubiFi or a comparable revenue recognition tool preferred

Bonus:

  • Experience with consumption/usage-based and subscription billing models

  • Familiarity with ASC 326 (CECL) and AR accounting in a high-volume SaaS context

  • Multi-entity or international revenue accounting background

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Central Europe or Eastern US timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts in linguistics, mixing and post-production to deliver human-edited dubs, audiobooks and more in 15+ languages, directly on the ElevenLabs platform. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.

We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:

  • Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

  • Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

  • Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.

We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.

Requirements

  • Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.

  • Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

  • Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

  • Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus:

  • Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

  • Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Healthcare: the health systems, hospitals, clinics, health plans, and life sciences companies people trust with their health and their families’ care. These organizations win or lose on trust and access at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to organizations reimagining how they serve patients, members, and clinicians, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the Healthcare industry

  • Balance a diverse pipeline of large health systems that require a white-glove experience with community hospitals, clinics, and regional providers that require speed to close

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in patient-facing and internal workflows, such as scheduling and reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, patient intake and outreach, and HCP support

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in healthcare AI governance

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (Patient Access and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, IT and Clinical Informatics, and Compliance, Privacy, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across facilities and service lines

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations, including BAAs

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Healthcare positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Healthcare experience (health systems, hospitals, payers, life sciences, health tech) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing six-and-seven figure deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (IT, product, and engineering) and business buyers (patient access, operations, digital), and to privacy and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including HIPAA, BAAs, and PHI data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
 This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

  • Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

  • Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

  • Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

  • Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

  • Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

  • Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

  • Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

  • Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

  • Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

About the role

We’re looking for an IT Support Engineer based out of our Warsaw office. This is a hybrid role - 4 days per week on-site and one day working from home.

 

What You'll Do

 

  • Device lifecycle management: assist with laptop procurement, setup, returns, and secure wiping

  • Office IT support: provide on-hand support to our colleagues in our Warsaw office, as well as support with expansions and/or office buildouts

  • AV support: ensure meeting rooms and AV equipment are running reliably

  • End-user support: be the first point of contact for the team by logging, prioritising and resolving support tickets in a timely manner, keeping end users informed throughout.

  • Onboarding: run IT onboarding calls for new joiners

  • New IT projects: contribute to IT initiatives

  • Automation and tooling: build automations and Slack bots to streamline repetitive work

  • Documentation: write and maintain clear internal IT documentation and guides (fixes, processes and playbooks) to continue building out our internal knowledge base

What you bring

  • A friendly, end-user focused attitude. You genuinely enjoy helping people solve problems.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to details and a proactive mindset.

  • Solid IT fundamentals (macOS, iOS and Android Operating systems, networking basics, SaaS tooling, AV systems etc.)

  • Hands-on experience with an MDM platform (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or similar)

  • Experience with Okta (or similar IdP) and understanding of access management principles, SSO, MFA and user/group management.

  • A willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills with a knack for writing helpful documentation.

Bonus

  • Prior experience in a high growth / startup environment

  • Experience in a customer or public-facing role

  • Experience with Agentic AI tooling

  • Familiarity with bash scripting

 

What we offer

At ElevenLabs, our biggest reward is shaping that future of voice technology. In addition, we offer:

  • Stock options; we want you to have ownership in the company and share the successes that lie ahead. That’s why we offer early employees stock options as part of their compensation package.

  • Extraordinary team; we favor ambitious, smart people striving for outsized impact. You’ll work on the state of the art surrounded by people with extraordinary skills and positive attitudes.

  • We offer competitive compensation and stock options. We are open to candidates of varying seniority. Given the broad range, we'll be happy to discuss specific salary details during our initial conversation.

  • Annual company off-sites; the last ones were in Croatia, Portugal and Switzerland.

This position will be 4 days on-site in our Warsaw office.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll create curricula across sales, pre-sales and technical implementation, starting with ElevenAgents and expanding across ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects.

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to:

  • Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments.

  • Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy.

  • Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

  • Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners.

  • Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons.

  • Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback.

Requirements

We're looking for an enablement builder who is comfortable with both commercial and technical topics. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

  • Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

  • Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

  • Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

  • Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

  • Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, tools and agents.

  • Have excellent communication skills and can adapt your message to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or in professional services for a frontier AI product.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications or voice and chat agents, and reviewing whether they are ready for production.

  • Familiarity with Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks and common integration patterns.

  • Telephony experience, such as SIP, Twilio or contact center platforms.

  • Experience at a systems integrator, hyperscaler or technology partner.

  • Experience with learning platforms such as WorkRamp.

  • Proficient in Spanish or Portuguese.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Leading a partner enablement team as the academy grows.

  • Moving into partner program leadership or Solutions Engineering.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in Americas timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced partnerships leader to own and scale ElevenLabs’ strategic relationships with cloud hyperscalers and Systems Integrators, the companies whose platforms, field teams and delivery capacity sit at the heart of how enterprises buy and deploy voice and customer experience AI.

You’ll build and manage co-sell and marketplace programmes with AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, and build joint GTM and delivery motions with Regional and Global Systems Integrators. The goal: get ElevenLabs deeply embedded in hyperscaler partner networks and SI practices, so that when enterprises modernize their contact centers or build on cloud infrastructure, ElevenLabs is the natural AI voice layer, and partners have both the incentive and the capacity to sell and deliver it.

This is a 0→1 build in a high-leverage category. You’ll design co-sell and SI GTM frameworks, drive pipeline with hyperscaler field teams, structure marketplace and private offer motions, negotiate referral, resell and joint-offering agreements with SIs, and own the revenue and pipeline outcomes that come from these relationships.

What success looks like (first 6-9 months)

  • Partner-sourced and influenced revenue: closed-won ARR attributable to hyperscaler and SI relationships

  • Hyperscaler marketplace and co-sell presence: listings live, co-sell registrations flowing, and active motions running with hyperscaler field teams

  • SI practice activation: named SI practice leads, certified practitioners and at least one joint offering or solution play in market

  • Partner-sourced pipeline: qualified opportunities sourced or co-sold through hyperscaler and SI field teams each quarter

  • Field activation: measurable engagement with hyperscaler sellers and SI client partners and delivery teams, not just BD or alliance leads, translating to warm intros and joint account planning

Requirements

  • 8+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, or GTM roles within SaaS or cloud, with direct experience running hyperscaler partner programmes and SI/GSI partnerships

  • Hands-on experience with hyperscaler co-sell programmes (AWS ISV Accelerate and ACE, Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Programme, Google Cloud Partner Advantage or equivalent) and marketplace operations (listings, private offers, commit burndown). You know how field co-sell actually works, not just the theory

  • Working knowledge of the SI ecosystem: relationships with practice leads and client partners at GSIs and RSIs, and an understanding of how SIs build practices, attach services to software ARR, and allocate delivery capacity

  • A builder mindset: experience creating co-sell and SI motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

  • Comfortable with technical, API-driven products; able to work with solutions engineers to scope solution architectures and articulate ElevenLabs’ value to technical partner audiences

  • Experience building enablement, certification or reference architectures that activate partner field and delivery teams at scale

  • Based in North America

  • Bonus: background combining 3-4 years in a quota-carrying sales or solutions role with 3-4 years in partnerships or alliances; prior experience at a company that successfully scaled through cloud marketplace and SI channels

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in US Eastern and Pacific timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the Nordics region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in English

  • Proven experience working across the Nordic market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

  • Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

  • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

  • Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities along with renewals

  • Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

jobs.title: SIP Expert
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a SIP Expert to own the telephony layer that connects ElevenAgents voice agents to the phone network. SIP traffic is moving from early adoption to large enterprise call volumes, so the hard problems are now reliability and latency at scale.

Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Owning SIP end to end, from design doc to implementation, testing and ongoing operation, for a product used by enterprises at scale.

  • Making call flows such as warm transfers dependable, and simplifying how our call services communicate with each other.

  • Diagnosing and fixing load-related failures such as resource exhaustion and dropped connections.

  • Collaborating with support, infrastructure and other teams to turn customer needs into shipped features.

Specific responsibilities might include:

  • Making our SIP edge and routing layer production-ready for large enterprise traffic.

  • Designing and shipping lightweight, lower-latency call-handling services.

  • Supporting carrier and SIP trunk integrations for enterprise customers.

You will join a small team of five, reporting directly to the team lead, with a high degree of ownership and very little bureaucracy.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or open source contributions.

We do require:

  • Experience building and operating large-scale SIP/VoIP systems in production, including debugging load-related failures such as port exhaustion, dropped connections and state shared across services

  • Hands-on experience running LiveKit (or comparable real-time media infrastructure) at scale, with comfort in WebSockets, WebRTC and RTP

  • Strong backend engineering in Go or a comparable systems language, and a record of owning projects from design document through launch and maintenance

  • Based in Europe or a nearby time zone, with at least 2 to 3 hours of daily overlap with CET

Bonus: Hands-on experience with Kamailio (or OpenSIPS/FreeSWITCH), or carrier and SIP trunk interconnects.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or nearby time zones, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 time zones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

We're hiring a GTM Lead to own how ElevenLabs builds outbound pipeline in North America. This isn't a traditional SDR management role. You'll lead a team of SDRs, build the AI agents and workflows that work alongside them, and stay close enough to the work to prospect and sell yourself.

You'll join at an exciting point: a strong SDR foundation is in place, new starters are joining, and more hires are planned as we grow. You'll define the next version of outbound here: what gets automated, what stays human, and how we break into new accounts and segments. Then you'll build it. We're an AI company, and our outbound motion should prove it.

This role is measured in pipeline dollars and revenue, not activity. If you've carried a closing number, built something real with AI, and get energy from developing people and watching your team win, we'd love to hear from you.

In this role you will:

  • Own outbound pipeline for our Corporate and Mid-Market segments in North America, with targets set in pipeline dollars and revenue

  • Lead and grow a team of SDRs, with more headcount planned

  • Stay hands-on as a player-coach: prospect, open new accounts, and coach in the moment

  • Build the AI agents, automations and signal-based workflows that let a lean team cover a large market, starting with ElevenLabs' own products

  • Run go-to-market experiments across segments, channels and markets, and double down on what works

  • Build onboarding, enablement and coaching that grow SDRs into future closers

  • Partner with Account Executives, sales leadership, marketing and RevOps on targets, ICP and a clean handoff to AEs

Requirements

  • 8+ years in B2B software or technology sales, including time in a closing seat (AE, account manager or full-cycle seller) where you carried a number and beat it

  • Experience leading people: managing SDRs, AEs or a mix, or building a sales function from the ground up

  • You build with AI, you don't just use it: you've shipped agents, automations or workflows that changed how you or your team sells, and you can walk us through them

  • Recent, hands-on outbound experience with technical and business buyers

  • You work from the numbers that matter (pipeline dollars, conversion, win rate, deal size) and you know CRM and modern outbound tooling well

  • A track record at fast-growing companies; you're comfortable with ambiguity and pace

  • Clear, concise communication, and a coaching style that makes people better

Bonus

  • Early-stage or Series A–D startup experience, especially as a founding AE or first go-to-market hire

  • Exposure to voice AI, AI agents, customer experience, or developer tools and APIs

  • You've already built something with ElevenLabs

  • Experience with globally distributed teams

Location

This role is remote-first and can be done from anywhere in the United States. You must be able to work in ET, CT, MT or PT time zones. We prefer candidates based in San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Field marketing is at the heart of how we build demand, foster community, deepen customer relationships, and accelerate growth. We are looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Field Marketing Manager to build the engine that fills the funnel for our Southern Europe GTM team, focused on two to three priority industries: healthcare, financial services, telco, and retail and e-commerce.

Your expertise in industry-led field marketing strategy, regional program execution, and GTM partnership will be pivotal in creating the moments that bring enterprise buyers to the table, from executive dinners and roadshows to industry conferences, roundtables, and account-based programs aimed at named buying committees. Collaborating closely with the Southern European GTM team and the broader marketing team, you will own every stage of the field motion, from territory and account strategy through budgeting, on-site execution, and post-program pipeline attribution.

ElevenAgents is being evaluated today by customer experience and contact center leaders at the largest health systems, banks, carriers, and retailers in Southern Europe. Your ability to think like a marketer, act like a salesperson, and run multiple industry programs at once will ensure we get in front of them first.

What you’ll do

  • Build the engine that fills the funnel for your industries, a repeatable program mix that creates net new pipeline quarter over quarter

  • Develop and execute the Southern Europe field plan for two to three industries, from territory and account strategy through budget, execution, and attribution

  • Partner with Enterprise and Strategic account executives on named account lists. Agree the targets, fill the room, drive the follow-up.

  • Design the program mix: executive dinners, industry conferences, roadshows, roundtables, customer advisory sessions, and 1:few account-based plays

  • Create the vertical narrative with Product Marketing. Invite copy, talk tracks, and follow-up sequences that speak to a healthcare, banking, telco, or retail buyer, not a generic one.

  • Manage event budgets and timelines, and report pipeline created and cost per opportunity, program by program

  • Analyze program performance in Salesforce and Dream Data and give an honest read on what worked. Recommend what to scale and what to retire.

  • Follow up with participants in collaboration with the GTM and growth teams

  • Work with Paid Media and Demand Generation to amplify field programs before and after they run

  • Own end to end execution, with support from the Southern Europe events team on venue, vendors, logistics, and on-site delivery

Requirements

We are more focused on hiring for potential than past experience, but the person who thrives here will bring most of the following.

  • 7+ years in B2B field, industry, or regional marketing, with a demonstrated track record of building programs that directly influenced pipeline and closed revenue

  • Deep experience marketing into at least two of: healthcare, financial services, telco, retail and e-commerce

  • Track record reaching enterprise buying committees on six and seven figure deals

  • Fluency in Salesforce and marketing attribution. You can defend your numbers in a pipeline review.

  • A peer relationship with GTM. You have pushed back on an account executive and been right.

  • Comfortable running an executive dinner, speaking at events, and partnering with C-level stakeholders inside and outside the company

  • Sharp judgment on what to cut. Budget and calendar discipline under tight deadlines.

  • Willing to travel roughly a third of the time across Southern Europe

  • Transparent and unafraid to challenge, ask questions, or call out obstacles

  • An AI-first working style, and a passion for ElevenLabs technology

  • Bias toward shipping

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Your expertise in industry-led field marketing strategy, regional program execution, and GTM partnership will be pivotal in creating the moments that bring enterprise buyers to the table, from executive dinners and roadshows to industry conferences, roundtables, and account-based programs aimed at named buying committees. Collaborating closely with the Southern European GTM team and the broader marketing team, you will own every stage of the field motion, from territory and account strategy through budgeting, on-site execution, and post-program pipeline attribution.

ElevenAgents is being evaluated today by customer experience and contact center leaders at the largest health systems, banks, carriers, and retailers in Southern Europe. Your ability to think like a marketer, act like a salesperson, and run multiple industry programs at once will ensure we get in front of them first.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build the engine that fills the funnel for your industries, a repeatable program mix that creates net new pipeline quarter over quarter

 - Develop and execute the Southern Europe field plan for two to three industries, from territory and account strategy through budget, execution, and attribution

 - Partner with Enterprise and Strategic account executives on named account lists. Agree the targets, fill the room, drive the follow-up.

 - Design the program mix: executive dinners, industry conferences, roadshows, roundtables, customer advisory sessions, and 1:few account-based plays

 - Create the vertical narrative with Product Marketing. Invite copy, talk tracks, and follow-up sequences that speak to a healthcare, banking, telco, or retail buyer, not a generic one.

 - Manage event budgets and timelines, and report pipeline created and cost per opportunity, program by program

 - Analyze program performance in Salesforce and Dream Data and give an honest read on what worked. Recommend what to scale and what to retire.

 - Follow up with participants in collaboration with the GTM and growth teams

 - Work with Paid Media and Demand Generation to amplify field programs before and after they run

 - Own end to end execution, with support from the Southern Europe events team on venue, vendors, logistics, and on-site delivery




REQUIREMENTS

We are more focused on hiring for potential than past experience, but the person who thrives here will bring most of the following.

 - 7+ years in B2B field, industry, or regional marketing, with a demonstrated track record of building programs that directly influenced pipeline and closed revenue

 - Deep experience marketing into at least two of: healthcare, financial services, telco, retail and e-commerce

 - Track record reaching enterprise buying committees on six and seven figure deals

 - Fluency in Salesforce and marketing attribution. You can defend your numbers in a pipeline review.

 - A peer relationship with GTM. You have pushed back on an account executive and been right.

 - Comfortable running an executive dinner, speaking at events, and partnering with C-level stakeholders inside and outside the company

 - Sharp judgment on what to cut. Budget and calendar discipline under tight deadlines.

 - Willing to travel roughly a third of the time across Southern Europe

 - Transparent and unafraid to challenge, ask questions, or call out obstacles

 - An AI-first working style, and a passion for ElevenLabs technology

 - Bias toward shipping

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Media & Entertainment - including film and television studios, streaming platforms, gaming companies, publishers, sports and media organizations, and other global content businesses.

Media and entertainment companies create, localize, and distribute enormous volumes of content across formats, languages, and markets. Voice and audio are central to those experiences, creating a significant opportunity for AI to accelerate production, expand global reach, deepen audience engagement, and unlock new creative possibilities.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about the transformative potential of AI voice technology and eager to act as a strategic partner, helping leading media and entertainment companies reimagine how they create, localize, distribute, and monetize content.

In this role, you will

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of enterprise Media & Entertainment accounts to help ElevenLabs achieve its revenue goals

  • Identify opportunities where voice and audio AI can drive growth, creative innovation, automation, or cost efficiency across workflows - including dubbing and localization, voiceover, audiobooks, gaming characters, pre- and post-production, marketing content, accessibility, and personalized audience experiences

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the Media & Entertainment and generative AI landscapes, including customer priorities, competitive solutions, emerging technologies, evolving business models, and industry considerations around rights and responsible AI

  • Demonstrate expertise around how ElevenLabs’ technology can create value across content production, localization, distribution, interactive experiences, creative workflows, and consumer-facing products

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the full buying group - including Content, Production, Localization, Creative, Product, Technology, Marketing, Legal, and Procurement

  • Navigate complex Media & Entertainment environments and identify opportunities to integrate ElevenLabs with existing production, localization, content-management, and distribution ecosystems

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to design high-impact solutions, manage successful Proofs of Value, and establish a path to scaled production deployment

  • Serve as a trusted advisor by educating customers on generative AI and voice while helping shape ElevenLabs’ Media & Entertainment playbook, including our ICP, messaging, use cases, and customer references

Requirements

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Experience selling to Media & Entertainment companies - including film and television studios, streaming platforms, gaming companies, publishers, sports and media organizations, or other global content businesses

  • An established network and strong relationships across the Media & Entertainment industry

  • Proven success closing seven-figure deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers, such as Product, Engineering, IT, and Architecture, and business buyers across Content, Production, Localization, Creative, Marketing, and Operations

  • Ability to understand a customer’s content strategy, production environment, and requirements for success, then translate ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver measurable creative and business value

  • Proficiency navigating enterprise procurement, security, legal, rights-management, and technical validation processes, with the ability to operate autonomously and partner effectively across functions

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships at the C-suite and senior leadership level, and a willingness to travel frequently for onsite customer meetings and industry events

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment where ambiguity is the norm and priorities evolve quickly

  • Passion for voice and audio AI and its potential to transform content creation, localization, distribution, and audience experiences across Media & Entertainment

Location

This role is remote-first and can be based anywhere in the United States; however, the ability to operate across EST, CST, or PST time zones is required. We have a preference for candidates based in New York, Los Angeles, or San Francisco, with the option to work from one of our offices where available.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
